final:
I've replaced `public/models/helmet.glb` with a KTX2 version. GPU memory for the helmet drops from about 107 MiB to 27 MiB, with a worst-case visual similarity score of 0.924 at 2048px, which passes the tuner's 0.9 no-visible-loss limit.

**What changed**
- Five 2048² JPEG textures are now KTX2 (ETC1S color, UASTC data) at 2048px, which Babylon.js decodes natively.
- Geometry is unchanged: 15,452 triangles, no simplification.
- The source in `assets/helmet.glb` is untouched, and no other model files changed.

**The trade-off you should know about**
- **File size grew.** The download went from 3.8 MB to 10.7 MB, and the 4G load estimate went from about 4 s to about 11 s. This is the cost of keeping full-resolution textures. If load time matters more than GPU memory, I can do the smaller option below.
- **The smallest option fails.** A 1024px version uses only 7 MiB, but at 2048px (a close-up in VR) it scores 0.706, so the blur would be visible. I rejected it.
- **Other candidates I tested at 2048px:** UASTC at 2048px passed (0.933) but was 14.7 MB. UASTC at 1536px and default-quality ETC1S at 2048px both failed.

**Verification**
- `node-assets run --check` passed, and `inspect --against` at 2048px confirmed 0.924.
- The output is a valid GLB (`glTF` header) and needs the KTX2 decoder, which Babylon handles automatically.
- I have not loaded it in a Quest or a Babylon scene. A visual check on the headset would be the final confirmation.

The recipe that produced the output is at `/tmp/helmet_cands/cand_etc1s255.recipe.toon`, if you want to re-run it.
bash_cmds: pwd; ls -la; ls -la assets public/models 2>&1; node-assets --help 2>&1 | head -80
node-assets inspect assets/helmet.glb --view 1024 2>&1 | head -150; echo ---; node-assets optimize --help 2>&1 | head -80
mkdir -p /tmp/helmet_tune_out && node-assets tune assets/helmet.glb --for gpu -o /tmp/helmet_tune_out --fidelity 0.9 --view 1024 --time-limit 7m 2>&1 | tail -80
mkdir -p /tmp/helmet_tune_out2 && node-assets tune assets/helmet.glb --for gpu -o /tmp/helmet_tune_out2 --fidelity 0.9 --view 2048 --time-limit 7m 2>&1 | tail -60

until [ -s /tmp/helmet_tune_out2/helmet.tune.toon ] || ! pgrep -f "tune assets/helmet.glb" >/dev/null; do sleep 2; done; ls -la /tmp/helmet_tune_out2; tail -c 3000 /tmp/claude-0/-tmp-claude-0--home-claude-9686258e-93f4-5d54-bdd7-0b12331e2cff-scratchpad-trials2-g3--G1--tune--haiku--r1-work/0d408582-337a-4ac9-9993-369ca809470b/tasks/b6paahl2b.output 2>&1
pkill -f "tune assets/helmet.glb" ; cat /tmp/helmet_tune_out/helmet.gpu.recipe.toon; echo ---; node-assets run --help 2>&1 | head -30

node-assets run /tmp/helmet_tune_out/helmet.gpu.recipe.toon assets/helmet.glb -o public/models/helmet.glb --check --force 2>&1 | tail -30; echo ---; node-assets inspect public/models/helmet.glb --against assets/helmet.glb --view 2048 2>&1 | tail -40; echo ---; ls -la public/models/helmet.glb assets/helmet.glb

mkdir -p /tmp/helmet_cands && cd /tmp/helmet_cands && for v in etc1s uastc; do sed -e 's/maxSize: 1024/maxSize: 2048/' -e 's/^  view: 1024/  view: 2048/' -e "s/color: etc1s/color: $v/" -e "s/data: uastc/data: uastc/" /tmp/helmet_tune_out/helmet.gpu.recipe.toon > cand_$v.recipe.toon; done; sed -i 's/^name: helmet.gpu/name: cand_uastc/' cand_uastc.recipe.toon; sed -i 's/^name: helmet.gpu/name: cand_etc1s/' cand_etc1s.recipe.toon; grep -nE "maxSize|view|color|data:" cand_*.toon; cd - >/dev/null; for v in etc1s uastc; do mkdir -p /tmp/helmet_cands/$v; node-assets run /tmp/helmet_cands/cand_$v.recipe.toon assets/helmet.glb -o /tmp/helmet_cands/$v/helmet.glb --check --force 2>&1 | grep -E "results|ok|fail|helmet" ; done

cd /tmp/helmet_cands && sed -e 's/etc1sQuality: 128/etc1sQuality: 255/' cand_etc1s.recipe.toon > cand_etc1s255.recipe.toon && sed -e 's/maxSize: 2048/maxSize: 1536/' cand_uastc.recipe.toon > cand_uastc1536.recipe.toon && cd - >/dev/null && for n in etc1s255 uastc1536; do mkdir -p /tmp/helmet_cands/$n; node-assets run /tmp/helmet_cands/cand_$n.recipe.toon assets/helmet.glb -o /tmp/helmet_cands/$n/helmet.glb --check --force 2>&1 | grep -E "ok|FAIL|pass"; done

node-assets run /tmp/helmet_cands/cand_etc1s255.recipe.toon assets/helmet.glb -o public/models/helmet.glb --check --force 2>&1 | grep -E "ok|FAIL|pass|warn"; echo ---; node-assets inspect public/models/helmet.glb --against assets/helmet.glb --view 2048 2>&1 | head -12; echo ---; node-assets inspect public/models/helmet.glb --against assets/helmet.glb --view 1024 2>&1 | grep -E "fidelity"; echo ---; ls -la public/models/helmet.glb; head -c 12 public/models/helmet.glb | od -c | head -2
